column3: NKJV has “their destructive ways,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “their sensuality.”
Close to the Greek; the verb “cast into Tartarus” is rendered “cast them down to hell.”
NKJV has “will receive the wages,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “suffering wrong as the wages.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV gives the name as “Beor,” where the Greek reads “Bosor.”
NKJV has “who have actually escaped,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “who are barely escaping.”
